title: The lattice face map is an isometry, with diameter at most √P on the closed unit cube
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let ι : Fin k → Fin P be injective, let b : Fin P → ℤ, and let Φ(y) := toLp(b) + Σ_{j : Fin k} y_j • e_{ι(j)} (Euclid k → Euclid P), where e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1 and toLp(b) has coordinates (b_i : ℝ). Then (a) dist(Φ(y), Φ(y')) = dist(y, y') for all y, y' ∈ Euclid k; and (b) if 0 ≤ y_i ≤ 1 and 0 ≤ y'_i ≤ 1 for all i, then dist(Φ(y), Φ(y')) ≤ √P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (ι : Fin k → Fin P) (b : Fin P → ℤ), Function.Injective ι → (∀ y y' : Euclid k, dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (b i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (b i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) = dist y y') ∧ (∀ y y' : Euclid k, (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y' i ∧ y' i ≤ 1) → dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (b i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (b i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) ≤ Real.sqrt P)
